mapper.select:
SELECT ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID, MODEL_NAME, DESCRIPTION, TARGET_SCHEMA, TARGET_TABLE, ENABLED, CURRENT_VERSION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SCHED_ANALYSIS_MODEL WHERE 1 = 1
AND MODEL_NAME LIKE '%' || #{searchDto.modelName} || '%'
AND ENABLED = #{searchDto.enabled}
ORDER BY ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID DESC

SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = #{targetSchema} AND TABLE_NAME = #{targetTable} AND IS_NULLABLE = 'NO' AND COLUMN_DEFAULT IS NULL AND IS_IDENTITY = 'NO' AND IS_GENERATED = 'NEVER' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
SELECT ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID, MODEL_NAME, DESCRIPTION, TARGET_SCHEMA, TARGET_TABLE, ENABLED, CURRENT_VERSION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SCHED_ANALYSIS_MODEL WHERE ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID = #{analysisModelId}

SELECT V.ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION_ID, V.ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID, V.VERSION_NO, V.TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID, V.CREATED_AT FROM SCHED_ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION V INNER JOIN SCHED_ANALYSIS_MODEL M ON V.ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID = M.ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID AND V.VERSION_NO = M.CURRENT_VERSION WHERE M.ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID = #{analysisModelId}

SELECT ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION_ID, ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID, VERSION_NO, TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID, CREATED_AT FROM SCHED_ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION WHERE ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID = #{analysisModelId} ORDER BY VERSION_NO DESC
SELECT ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION_ID, ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID, VERSION_NO, TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID, CREATED_AT FROM SCHED_ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION WHERE ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION_ID = #{analysisModelVersionId}

SELECT ANALYSIS_FIELD_ID, ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION_ID, TARGET_COLUMN, CAST(SOURCE_FIELDS AS TEXT) AS SOURCE_FIELDS_JSON, CONVERT_TYPE, CONVERT_FORMAT, REQUIRED_YN, SORT_ORDER FROM SCHED_ANALYSIS_MODEL_FIELD WHERE ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION_ID = #{analysisModelVersionId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, ANALYSIS_FIELD_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHED_ANALYSIS_MODEL ( MODEL_NAME, DESCRIPTION, TARGET_SCHEMA, TARGET_TABLE, ENABLED, CURRENT_VERSION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{modelName}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{targetSchema}, #{targetTable}, #{enabled}, #{currentVersion}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO SCHED_ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION ( ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID, VERSION_NO, TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{analysisModelId}, #{versionNo}, #{transformRuleVersionId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO SCHED_ANALYSIS_MODEL_FIELD ( ANALYSIS_MODEL_VERSION_ID, TARGET_COLUMN, SOURCE_FIELDS, CONVERT_TYPE, CONVERT_FORMAT, REQUIRED_YN, SORT_ORDER ) VALUES ( #{field.analysisModelVersionId}, #{field.targetColumn}, CAST(#{sourceFieldsJson} AS JSONB), #{field.convertType}, #{field.convertFormat, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{field.requiredYn}, #{field.sortOrder} )
mapper.update: UPDATE SCHED_ANALYSIS_MODEL SET MODEL_NAME = #{modelName}, DESCRIPTION = #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ENABLED = #{enabled}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ANALYSIS_MODEL_ID = #{analysisModelId} AND CURRENT_VERSION = #{currentVersion}
